scriptLines: source2 derive(admission_date = case(regexMatch(admission_date, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(admission_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(admission_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(admission_date, 'MM-dd-yy'),      regexMatch(admission_date, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(admission_date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(admission_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(admission_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(admission_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{1,2}, [0-9]{4}$'), toDate(admission_date, 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      toDate(toString(null()))),

discharge_date = case(regexMatch(discharge_date, '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(discharge_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),      regexMatch(discharge_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'), toDate(discharge_date, 'MM-dd-yy'),      regexMatch(discharge_date, '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(discharge_date, 'MM/dd/yyyy'),      regexMatch(discharge_date, '^[0-9]{2}-[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$'), toDate(discharge_date, 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),      regexMatch(discharge_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]{1,2}, [0-9]{4}$'), toDate(discharge_date, 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),      toDate(toString(null())))) ~> derivedColumn1

derivedColumn1 derive(department = case(regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(general ?surgery|gen surg)$'), 'General Surgery',      regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(cardiology|cardiolgy|cardio)$'), 'Cardiology',      regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(emergency|emergancy|er)$'), 'Emergency',      regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(pediatrics|paediatrics|peds)$'), 'Pediatrics',      regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(oncology|oncologyy|onco)$'), 'Oncology',      regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(neurology|nuerology|neuro)$'), 'Neurology',      regexMatch(lower(trim(department)), '^(orthopedics|orthopaedics|ortho)$'), 'Orthopedics',      'Unknown')) ~> derivedColumn2
derivedColumn2 derive(discharge_date = iif(discharge_date < admission_date, toDate(toString(null())), discharge_date)) ~> derivedColumn3
